description.value: The Hemlock Grove Boardwalk is a circular nature walk through old-growth forest within Glacier National Park, located near Rogers Pass along the Trans-Canada Highway. The boardwalk winds through moss-draped cedars in what Parks Canada describes as the world's only inland cedar rainforest. It lies within a park renowned for dramatic alpine scenery and deep river valleys, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists travelling the Trans-Canada corridor.
